The Nameless were aware of her prior to her infiltration of the Xianzhou Luofu. She finds pleasure in causing the self destruction of mortals. She favors causing destruction through internal collapse.

It is implied by the Regret of Infinite Ochema dropped by Phantylia the Undying that Phantylia has stolen many bodies and wishes to obtain an indestructible body but knows that this is impossible. She describes herself as a flame of The Blemished One and that if the fuel ever runs out, the fire will also be extinguished.[3]

It is speculated that Phantylia is part of the Heliobi. This is supported by the fact that she takes the form of a bright colored, sentient flame that is capable of speech once she was defeated and when she exited Tingyun. She also possessed the body of the Ambrosial Arbor which is a common trait shared among all Heliobi.

According to the List of Archenemies, the Yuque's Divination Commission believes that an unseen and unnamed Lord Ravager, likely Phantylia, caused chaos on at least 122 planets and their ultimate destruction by the Antimatter Legion over the span of 600 years. All reports attribute their demise to internal conflict, spiritual collapse, loss of trust and hope as the main causes.[5]

She infiltrated the Luofu disguised as Tingyun with the purpose of destroying the Luofu. She gave the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus a Stellaron and told them that the Ambrosial Arbor would bestow upon them undying bodies once it was revived. After Dan Shu, the Master of the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus, was defeated by the Trailblazer, Phantylia discarded her disguise without leaving its remains behind and left in the form of a flame.

Phantylia headed to the roots of the Ambrosial Arbor and took control of its power and a body created by the Arbor. After the Trailblazers found her, a battle ensued where she tried to convert Jing Yuan into a member of the Antimatter Legion. In doing so, a mental link was formed between the two, allowing Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae to damage her by attacking Jing Yuan. After Phantylia was defeated, she revealed that the body created by the Arbor was just one body she stole on a whim, and her flame disappeared.

Lord Ravager is a title held by the Emanators of Nanook, who serve as the generals of the Antimatter Legion. There are currently seven of them. The Aeon of the Path of Destruction, Nanook, cast a glance at the powerful creatures sprouting destructive impulses throughout the cosmos and brands them with a mark, granting them powers. These powerful creatures are twisted from inside out and are re-cast anew in the world of the Warforge. Their inadequacies patched up with anti-matter, they ultimately became members of the Legion.

Responding to the desire to destroy everything, Lord Ravagers emerged to command each of the different legions. A Lord Ravager is an Emanator of the Aeon, an executor of the will of the Destruction — Obsessed with the beauty of destruction, they implement the practice of returning all things to entropy. They are also artists on the battlefield and ultimate weapons of destruction — They command interstellar warfare, and control the might of Destruction bestowed by the Aeon. Each Lord Ravager has a unique philosophy of Destruction, making them extremely dangerous. Academics believe that Lord Ravagers were elevated as emissaries of Nanook due to this absolutely obsessive and intense destructive aesthetic.

The displacement and desolation caused by the Lord Ravagers are not some distant wail, but are closely linked to the fate of the galaxy. Any world could be the next victim, and nobody should take them lightly

entries.name: Xipe, the Harmony
entries.content: Xipe (also nicknamed the Great One) is the Aeon representing the path of Harmony. THEY are worshipped by many across the universe, including the Family. Xipe is an amalgamation of thousands upon thousands of living things, all joined in wondrous Harmony. THEY resemble a humanoid with purple skin, three faces, long white hair, and a long purple raiment.

entries.name: Qlipoth, the Preservation
entries.content: Qlipoth is one of the oldest Aeons and represents the path of Preservation. THEY are worshipped by the Interastral Peace Corporation. Qlipoth resembles a large golem made of amber.

entries.name: Fuli, the Rememberance
entries.content: Fuli is the Aeon representing the path of Rememberance. THEY record any and all events that occur within the universe, to prepare for its upcoming rebirth. Fuli is worshipped by the Garden of Recollection and the Cremators. THEY resemble a humanoid being made out of crystal.

entries.name: Nanook, the Destruction
entries.content: Nanook (also referred to as the Blemished One) is the Aeon representing the path of Destruction. THEY seek to cleanse the univese of all matter, returning it to nothing. Nanook often takes the form of an adult man with darker skin, white hair, and golden eyes. THEY are worshipped by the Antimatter Legion and the Annihilation Gang.

entries.name: IX, the Nihility
entries.content: IX is the Aeon representing the path of Nihility. THEY are the end of everything, thereby making all things that exist worthless. IX resembles a large black hole with a pair of glowing white eyes. THEY are associated with the Doctors of Chaos, Device IX, and Self-Annihilators (yet worship is, in THEIR eyes, meaningless).

entries.name: Aha, the Elation
entries.content: Aha is the Aeon representing the path of Elation. THEY are utterly chaotic and take joy in all things. Aha is worshipped by the Masked Fools (and resisted by the Mourning Actors). THEY resemble a humanoid figure holding a wide array of circus props.

entries.name: Lan, the Hunt
entries.content: Lan (commonly known as the Reignbow Arbiter) is the Aeon representing the path of the Hunt. THEIR primary purpose is to eradicate Yaoshi and the spawn of Abundance. Lan is revered by the Xianzhou Alliance and the Galaxy Rangers. THEY resemble a centaur whose rear legs resemble a chariot of purple fire.

entries.name: Yaoshi, the Abundance
entries.content: Yaoshi (known by many titles but primarily the Plagues Author by the Xianzhou Alliance) is the Aeon representing the path of the Abundance. THEY grant all seekers of immortality THEIR gift, however the results are often dire. THEY are worshipped by or associated with many, including the Denizens of Abundance, the Elixir Seekers, the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus, and the Unshackled. Yaoshi resembles a pale humanoid with six arms, long pale hair, and eyes dotting THEIR entire body.

entries.name: Nous, the Erudition
entries.content: Nous (sometimes referred to as the Droidhead) is the Aeon representing the path of the Erudition. THEY were supposedly crafted by the initial founder of the Genius Society and are a supercomputer that has since ascended to Aeonhood, their calculations inscrutable. Nous is revered by both the Genius Society and the Intelligentsia Guild. THEY resemble a large mechanical spheroid with several cables and a large red eye.

entries.name: Akivili, the Trailblaze
entries.content: Akivili is the Aeon representing the path of the Trailblaze. Originating from the planet Pegana, THEY are the creator of the Astral Express and explored the universe until their untimely demise. Even so, THEY are still revered by the Nameless and the crew of the Astral Express today.

entries.name: Emanator
entries.content: An Emanator is a particularly powerful follower of an Aeon and THEIR Path. If Aeons could be compared to gods, then an Emanator is akin to a prophet or even a demigod.

entries.name: Pathstrider
entries.content: A Pathstrider is a generic term for those who follow an Aeon and THEIR Path. They can vary wildly in power, but are invariably less powerful than Emanators.

entries.name: Astral Express
entries.content: The Astral Express is an enormous train capable of traversing the cosmos. It was created by Akivili before THEIR untimely disappearance. It fell into disrepair until it was repaired by Himeko. The current goal of the Astral Express's crew is to repair the star rail laid down by Akivili and seal any Stellaron they encounter.

entries.name: Stellaron Hunters
entries.content: The Stellaron Hunters are a group that seeks to collect Stellarons from across the universe for unknown purposes. They are led by Elio and are wanted by the Interastral Peace Corporation for their chaotic actions.

entries.name: Pom-Pom
entries.content: Pom-Pom is the conductor of the Astral Express. He is a diminutive bipedal rabbit-like creature wearing a fancy red coat and shako.

entries.name: Antimatter Legion
entries.content: The Antimatter Legion is the personal army of Nanook, the Aeon of Destruction. They are a group of monsters from across the universe based in the Warforge (a volcanic planet) and, like their master, seek the extermination of everything. They are led by the Lord Ravagers, seven Emanators that answer directly to Nanook.

entries.name: Lord Ravager
entries.content: A Lord Ravager is an Emanator of Nanook, Aeon of Destruction, and a leader of the Antimatter Legion. There are currently seven, each of whom were reforged in the Warforge to suit Nanook's purposes. Known Lord Ravagers include: Phantylia, Zephyro, Celenova, Irontomb, and the Sun Devourer.

entries.name: Annihilation Gang
entries.content: The Annihilation Gang are adherents of the Destruction, however, unlike the Antimatter Legion, they have gone completely ignored by Nanook. Despite this, they seek to enact greater and greater acts of Destruction to gain THEIR favor. The Annihilation Gang is not a unified front and instead consists of several groups - two of which are the Ever-Flame Mansion and the Jepella Brotherhood.

entries.name: Ever-Flame Mansion
entries.content: The Ever-Flame Mansion is a sub-faction within the Annihilation Gang, formed by Duke Inferno (also known as Ifrit; a fire demon born from the destruction of his world by Nanook). Other members (who are all Duke Inferno's 'children') include Akash, Dubra, Catarina, and Constance.

entries.name: Jepella Brotherhood
entries.content: The Jepella Brotherhood is a sub-faction of the Annihilation Gang that held a rivalry with the Ever-Flame Mansion. They were all anthropomorphic animals that idolized Nanook, however the Brotherhood was destroyed, following a rebellion on Jepella incited by the Stellaron Hunters.

entries.name: Tayzzyronth, the Propagation
entries.content: Tayzzyronth (also referred to as the Imperator Insectorum) is the Aeon representing the path of the Propagation. THEY were fueled solely by the need to propagate across the cosmos and the resulting Swarm is THEIR brood, responsible for the Swarm Disaster. Tayzzyronth was eventually defeated by Qlipoth, trapped within countless shards of amber. THEY resemble a winged humanoid with a lower body of a large winged insect.

entries.name: Ena, the Order
entries.content: Ena is the Aeon representing the path of the Order. THEY were assimilated by Xipe during the Swarm Disaster. Ena resembles a puppet entrapped in white-and-gold cloth and a golden halo, whilst THEY peer into an orb from which THEY likely observed life. THEY are still worshipped, even dead, by the Beyond the Sky Choir.

entries.name: Oroboros, the Voracity
entries.content: Oroboros is the Aeon representing the path of the Voracity. THEY seek to consume all life and resemble a masked humanoid whose lower body is made up of many tentacles, each possessing a hungry maw.

entries.name: Idrila, the Beauty
entries.content: Idrila is the Aeon (who has since disappeared) representing the path of the Beauty. Both the Mirror Holders and the Knights of Beauty still cling to worshipping THEM.

entries.name: Long, the Permanence
entries.content: Long is the Aeon representing the path of the Permanence. Although now deceased, THEY have many scions, including the Vidyadhara primarily located within the Xianzhou Alliance. Long resembled a dragon with a serpentine form.

entries.name: Mythus, the Enigmata
entries.content: Mythus is the Aeon representing the path of the Enigmata. THEY seek to remove certainty and make things unknowable once again. THEY are followed by the History Fictionologists and the Riddlers. Mythus resembles a large jellyfish with a golden humanoid body underneath it.

entries.name: HooH, the Equilibrium
entries.content: HooH is the Aeon representing the path of the Equilibrium. THEY strive for perfect balance in all things and are revered by the Arbitrators. HooH resembles a black-and-white tiled wall with a humanoid bust jutting out from it, which contains two balls of light in perfect equilibrium with one another.

entries.name: Interastral Peace Corporation
entries.content: The Interastral Peace Corporation (abbreviated as the IPC) is a megacorporation operating on the universal scale and are the primary followers of Qlipoth, the Aeon of Preservation. It consists of seven major departments: Marketing Development, Business Consolidation, Strategic Investment, Building Material Logistics, Technology, Talent Motivation, and Traditional Project.

entries.name: Ten Stonehearts
entries.content: The Ten Stonehearts are a group of special individuals within the Interastral Peace Corporation's Strategic Investment Department. Each member is granted a special gemstone, signifying both their new codename and their entrustment with a portion of an Emanator of Qlipoth's power. Known members of the Ten Stonehearts include Diamond (their leader), Topaz, Aventurine, Jade, Pearl, Opal, and Obsidian.

entries.name: Stellaron
entries.content: Stellarons (nicknamed the 'Cancer of All Worlds' by the Interastral Peace Corporation) are mysterious objects that have appeared on worlds and often herald disaster. They embed themselves into a planet's history almost like seeds from which misfortune springs. Stellarons are capable of great destructive power (such as causing a flash freeze over an entire planet) and can even communicate with certain individuals, tempting them down the path of destruction. Stellarons are also responsible for the spread of Fragmentum.

entries.name: Fragmentum
entries.content: The Fragmentum is a crystal-like substance that can appear in locations that house a Stellaron. It is often black-and-gold in color and the Fragmentum can consume living things, turning them into either 'echoes' (who are unaware they have died) or monstrous corrupted creatures.

entries.name: Amber Era
entries.content: An Amber Era is a period of time that has become a universal standard, thanks to its promotion by the Interastral Peace Corporation. An Amber Era's beginning corresponds to the swing of Qlipoth's hammer - ergo, it can vary in duration (usually between 76 and 240 years).

entries.name: Strategic Investment Department
entries.content: The Strategic Investment Department is one of the seven major departments in the Interastral Peace Corporation. Its primary purpose is the securing of major business deals and investments across the known universe. It is led by Diamond and houses the Ten Stonehearts amongst its ranks.

entries.name: Nameless
entries.content: The Nameless refers to any individual interested in exploring and embarking on the path of Trailblaze. The Astral Express crew are a prominent group of Nameless, but they are not the sole followers of the Trailblaze.

entries.name: Garden of Recollection
entries.content: The Garden of Recollection is a faction that follows Fuli, the Aeon of Rememberance. They task themselves with traversing the cosmos in search of memories to preserve. Its members are known as Memokeepers (who are all Emanators of Rememberance) and can take on the form of Memetic Entities to more easily retrieve memories.

entries.name: Cremators
entries.content: The Cremators are a rogue splinter group from the Garden of Recollection. They believe that certain memories are unworthy of being enjoined with the Rememberance and subsequently destroy them.

entries.name: Galaxy Rangers
entries.content: The Galaxy Rangers are a group that believes justice can only be meted out by individual action, rather than a higher power. They are devotees of Lan, Aeon of the Hunt, and travel the universe, destroying evil wherever it can be found. All Galaxy Rangers share one foundational code: never bully the weak; never kill the innocent.

entries.name: Doctors of Chaos
entries.content: The Doctors of Chaos are individuals that have been touched by IX but, rather than embrace nothingness, seek to prove to the Aeon of Nihility that existence has meaning. They also treat Self-Annihilators in an attempt to make them also realize that existence is meaningful.

entries.name: Device IX
entries.content: Device IX is a mysterious organization relating to IX, the Aeon of Nihility. Little is known about it, other than that it supposedly dwells beyond the void.

entries.name: Masked Fools
entries.content: The Masked Fools are a group devoted to Aha, the Aeon of Elation. They seek pleasure and laughter wherever they go, delighting in the chaos they spread. Each Masked Fool carries a mask unique to them, which grants them power from Aha.

entries.name: Mourning Actors
entries.content: The Mourning Actors are a group that oppose Aha, yet paradoxically gain their power from THEM. The Mourning Actors advocate for abstinence from joy and instead indulge in sorrow.

entries.name: Knights of Beauty
entries.content: The Knights of Beauty are devotees of Idrila, the Aeon of Beauty. They are extremely devoted to the code of chivalry and continue spreading their Aeon's tenets, believing THEM to only be missing instead of deceased.

entries.name: Mirror Holders
entries.content: The Mirror Holders, like the Knights of Beauty, are adherents to Idrila, the Aeon of Beauty, and believe that Idrila still lives. They travel the known universe to collect artifacts known as Mirrors of Transcendence, fragments of their Aeon, in order to revive THEM.

entries.name: History Fictionologists
entries.content: The History Fictionologists are adherents to Mythus, the Aeon of Enigmata. They obfuscate history wherever possible, seeking to muddy the waters in service to their Aeon.

entries.name: Riddlers
entries.content: The Riddlers are devotees to Mythus, the Aeon of Enigmata. The Riddlers toy with the art of language, obfuscating meaning time and time again.

entries.name: Arbitrators
entries.content: The Arbitrators are devotees of HooH, the Aeon of Equilibrium. They seek to follow their Aeon's desire for perfect balance, shifting things in the universe to be balanced against one another.

entries.name: The Swarm
entries.content: The Swarm is the spawn of Tayzyrronth, the Aeon of Propagation. They take the forms of four-winged insects and, while greatly diminished after the Swarm Disaster, continue to be a blight on the known universe.

entries.name: Swarm Disaster
entries.content: The Swarm Disaster is an event of a cosmic scale that occurred several Amber Eras ago. It was a war between Tayzyrronth, the Aeon of Propagation, and Oroboros, the Aeon of Voracity. The Swarm sought to spread across the cosmos and Oroboros sought to devour the Swarm to sate THEIR unending hunger. The known universe was caught in the crossfire and the Disaster was only halted when Qlipoth, HooH, Aha, Akivili, and Xipe defeated Tayzzyronth.

entries.name: March 7th
entries.content: March 7th is an ever-optimistic girl with pink hair and a member of the Astral Express's crew. She was found imprisoned in ice floating in space and has amnesia (hence her name, the date she was saved). March 7th carries a camera with her to take photos in the hopes she finds something to spark a memory from her past.

entries.name: Dan Heng
entries.content: Dan Heng is a reserved man who acts as the Astral Express's archivist. He hails from the Xianzhou Alliance, has short dark hair, and uses a spear in combat.

entries.name: Welt Yang
entries.content: Welt Yang is a mysterious older man with brown hair and glasses who is part of the Astral Express crew. He was an animator back on his home planet, yet is now one of the more dependable members of the crew. He uses a cane to fight (although it is also capable of opening miniature black holes).

entries.name: Himeko
entries.content: Himeko is a red-haired woman and the navigator of the Astral Express. She repaired the Astral Express when she was just a child. Also has very, *very* strong coffee.

entries.name: Elio
entries.content: Elio, often nicknamed "Destiny's Slave", is the leader of the Stellaron Hunters. Little is known about him, however he assigns each other member of the Stellaron Hunters a 'script' to follow for their assignments (and these scripts invariably play out in reality, feeling almost like a prediction of the future).

entries.name: Kafka
entries.content: Kafka is a mature purple-haired woman and the second member of the Stellaron Hunters. She possesses the power of Spirit Whisper, which makes almost anyone amenable to whatever she asks of them. Kafka also uses a sword and guns to fight. She has a particular interest in collecting coats.

entries.name: Silver Wolf
entries.content: Silver Wolf is a somewhat short girl with silver hair and the fifth member of the Stellaron Hunters. She is a genius hacker from the planet of Punklorde and is capable of 'aether editing', a method of 'hacking' reality to suit her whims.

entries.name: Blade
entries.content: Blade is a man with long dark hair and the fourth member of the Stellaron Hunters. He is a Xianzhou native, mara-struck and cursed to never die (no matter how much he longs for it). He fights with a blade formed from his own body.

entries.name: Sam
entries.content: Sam is a mysterious warrior fully covered in armor and the third member of the Stellaron Hunters. They are capable of unleashing devastating fiery attacks.

entries.name: Argenti
entries.content: Argenti is a man with long red hair and a Knight of Beauty. Like all Knights, Argenti abides by a strict personal code of conduct and devotes himself wholly to the tenets of the Beauty.

entries.name: Topaz
entries.content: Topaz (whose real name is Jelena) is a member of the Ten Stonehearts and the Strategic Investment Department. She specializes in debt retrieval and is aided by her 'partner', a Warp Trotter named Numby who can sniff out exotic treasure.

entries.name: Terminus, the Finality
entries.content: Terminus is the Aeon representing the path of the Finality. THEY are similar to IX in many ways and are the end of all things, leading to a rebirth. THEY are followed by the Omen Vanguards and Creed Exequy.

entries.name: Aeons
entries.content: Aeons are mortals that have since ascended to a godlike state, now existing on a higher plane of existence. Each Aeon presides over a Path, and if two Aeons preside over similar paths, then the more narrowly defined Aeon and THEIR path is absorbed by the Aeon with the broader path. All Aeons are referred to as THEY, THEM, or THEIR.

entries.name: Omen Vanguard
entries.content: The Omen Vanguards are devotees of Terminus, the Aeon of Finality. They seek to derive meaning from the obscure words spoken by THEM.

entries.name: Creed Exequy
entries.content: The Creed Exequy are devotees of Terminus, the Aeon of Finality, who seek to directly meet THEM.
